```{r B cell subset}

library(Seurat) 
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(writexl)
library(dplyr)

#read the .rds file
data <- readRDS("/path_to_folder/HarmonyIntegrated_annotated_data_final.rds")

data$CellTypes <- Idents(data)

#Subset B cell cluster
bcell <- subset(data, idents = c("B cells"))

```

## Read the senescence -associated geneset as deetrmined 
## using Desktop application for GSEA

```{r senescence-associated geneset }
# Read the identified senescence associated geneset
genes <- read.csv("/path_to_folder/B cell senescence_genes.csv")

# Read the column called "gene"
gene_list <- genes$gene
```

#Extract the counts info

```{r Extract normalized expression across samples}

# Get normalized data
expr <- GetAssayData(
  bcell,
  assay = "RNA",
  layer = "data"
)

# Keep genes present
genes <- intersect(gene_list, rownames(expr))

# Metadata
meta <- bcell@meta.data

meta$group <- paste(
  meta$CellTypes,
  meta$sample,
  sep = "_"
)

unique(meta$group)

expr <- GetAssayData(
  bcell,
  assay = "RNA",
  layer = "data"
)

genes <- intersect(gene_list, rownames(expr))

avg_expr <- sapply(unique(meta$group), function(g) {

  cells <- rownames(meta)[meta$group == g]

  rowMeans(expr[genes, cells, drop = FALSE])

})

final_table <- as.data.frame(t(avg_expr))

final_table$group <- rownames(final_table)

#reorder the file
final_table$cluster <- sub("_(.*)", "", final_table$group)

final_table$sample <- sub("(.*)_", "", final_table$group)

final_table <- final_table[, c(
  "cluster",
  "sample",
  genes
)]

head(final_table)

#Write the final table
write.csv(final_table, "/path_to_folder/Figure 4B/bcell_senescence_gene_expression.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r add the group column}

final_table$group <- case_when(
  grepl("^NS", final_table$sample) ~ "NS",
  grepl("^Sm", final_table$sample) ~ "Sm",
  grepl("^C",  final_table$sample) ~ "C",
  TRUE ~ "Other"
)


write.csv(
  final_table,
  "/path_to_folder/Figure 4B/Bcell_sample_expression_grouped.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

```

```{r identify log2FC between COPD vs NS}

#Subset the results

ns <- subset(final_table, group == "NS")
copd <- subset(final_table, group == "C")
sm <- subset(final_table, group == "Sm")

gene_cols <- setdiff(colnames(final_table), c("cluster","sample","group"))

ns_mean   <- colMeans(ns[, gene_cols])
copd_mean <- colMeans(copd[, gene_cols])

#Calculate log2 FC- COPD vs NS
log2FC <- log2(copd_mean + 1e-6) -
          log2(ns_mean + 1e-6)

#Wilcoxan test
genes <- colnames(final_table)[4:ncol(final_table)]
data_sub <- subset(final_table, group %in% c("NS", "C"))

genes <- setdiff(colnames(final_table), c("cluster","sample","group"))

pvals <- sapply(genes, function(gene) {

  wilcox.test(
    data_sub[[gene]][data_sub$group == "C"],
    data_sub[[gene]][data_sub$group == "NS"], 
    exact = FALSE
  )$p.value

})


#p adj value
padj <- p.adjust(pvals, method = "BH")

#Combine results

results <- data.frame(
  gene = genes,
  log2FC = log2FC,
  pvalue = pvals,
  padj = padj
)


padj_cutoff <- 1.1

upregulated <- subset(results, log2FC > 1.5)
up_genes <- upregulated$gene

head(upregulated)

downregulated <- subset(results, log2FC < -1.5)
down_genes <- downregulated$gene

head(downregulated)

write.csv(results, "/path_to_folder/Figure 4B/B_cell_senescence_fold_change_scRNA_results.csv")

write.csv(upregulated, "/path_to_folder/Figure 4B/upregulated_genes_Bcells_copd_vs_ns_Sen.csv", row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(downregulated, "/path_to_folder/Figure 4B/downregulated_genes_Bcells_copd_vs_ns_Sen.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

```{r get the z-scored expression for plotting}
#subset the expression data per sample
expr_up <- final_table[, up_genes]
expr_down <- final_table[, down_genes]

#compute Z score for both

z_up <- scale(expr_up) 
z_down <- scale(expr_down)


z_up_df <- cbind(final_table[, c("sample")], z_up)
z_down_df <- cbind(final_table[, c("sample")], z_down)

z_up_df <- t(z_up_df)
z_down_df <- t(z_down_df)


Sig_Sen_genes_B_cells <- rbind(z_up_df, z_down_df)

head(Sig_Sen_genes_B_cells)

write.csv(Sig_Sen_genes_B_cells, "/path_to_folder/Figure 4B/Zscore_sig_DEGs_Bcells_Sen_20260225.csv", row.names = TRUE)

```
